TEXT.source: ['18. manazataza ka no anito', '與鬼捕魚', 'Catching fish with a ghost', '', 'si apen Kotan/Manokos (F, 74, Iranmilek)', '謝芹容，女，74，東清村', '']

S.FORM: ko i-panci a ciri-ciring am, ma-ngay ma-naoy sira o tao nokakoa am,
S.PHON: k[o|u] ipanci a ciriciriŋ am maŋaj mana[o|u]j ʂira [o|u] ta[o|u] n[o|u]kak[o|u]a am
S.FORM: ko ipanci a ciriciring am, mangay manaoy sira o tao nokakoa am,
S.PHON: k[o|u] ipanʨi a ʨiɻiʨiɻiŋ am maŋaj mana[o|u]j ɕiɻa [o|u] ta[o|u] n[o|u]kak[o|u]a am
S.TRANSL: 我要講的故事是，古時候的人去捕魚的故事
The story I am about to tell is about a man who went fishing.

S.FORM: "mi ta ma-naza-taza, mo ke-hakay", mi sira ma-naza-taza am, ni-maka-tey-tey-laod o ji a-cita so moing a, o tao am mi-palit sira, ta am-ian do tey-rala ma-noyo.
S.PHON: mi ta manaʐataʐa m[o|u] kəʁakaj mi ʂira manaʐataʐa am nimakatəjtəjla[o|u]ɖ [o|u] ʥi acita ʂ[o|u] m[o|u]iŋ a [o|u] ta[o|u] am mipalit ʂira ta amian ɖ[o|u] təjrala man[o|u]j[o|u]
S.FORM: "mi ta manazataza, mo kehakay", mi sira manazataza am, nimakateyteylaod o ji acita so moing a, o tao am mipalit sira, ta amian do teyrala manoyo.
S.PHON: mi ta manaratara m[o|u] kəɰakaj mi ɕiɻa manaratara am nimakatəjtəjla[o|u]ɖ [o|u] ʥi aʨita ʂ[o|u] m[o|u]iŋ a [o|u] ta[o|u] am mipalit ɕiɻa ta amian ɖ[o|u] təjɻala man[o|u]j[o|u]
S.TRANSL: ＂朋友，我們去捕魚＂ ，他們兩個人就一起去捕魚了；鬼（看不見臉的）在靠海的一邊（撈魚），而人類在靠岸的地方趕魚
"Friend, let's go fishing." The two of them went fishing.The ghost, (whose face could not be seen), was near the sea (catching fish, and the human stood near the shore herding fish.

S.FORM: a no mi na toyo-en am, ni-man-manma pa o tao a ma-naza,
S.PHON: a n[o|u] mi na t[o|u]j[o|u]ən am nimanmanma pa [o|u] ta[o|u] a manaʐa
S.FORM: a no mi na toyoen am, nimanmanma pa o tao a manaza,
S.PHON: a n[o|u] mi na t[o|u]j[o|u]ən am nimanmanma pa [o|u] ta[o|u] a manara
S.TRANSL: 當他趕魚的時候。應該是人類先拿撈網網魚才對
When the ghost started to drive out the fish, the man would have the net ready.

S.FORM: "toyo rana, ta pa-laod rana, toyo rana o zawang ang" koan na,
S.PHON: t[o|u]j[o|u] rana ta pala[o|u]ɖ rana t[o|u]j[o|u] rana [o|u] ʐawaŋ aŋ k[o|u]an na
S.FORM: "toyo rana, ta palaod rana, toyo rana o zawang ang" koan na,
S.PHON: t[o|u]j[o|u] ɻana ta pala[o|u]ɖ ɻana t[o|u]j[o|u] ɻana [o|u] rawaŋ aŋ k[o|u]an na
S.TRANSL: 人類說＂你可以趕魚了，把水溝的魚趕到出海口來！＂
"You can start herding the fish now. Herd all the fish into the sea through the channel," the human said.

S.FORM: mak-among sira am, "ikongo ori o among ta ori, mo ke-hakay ang",
S.PHON: makam[o|u]ŋ ʂira am ik[o|u]ŋ[o|u] [o|u]ri [o|u] am[o|u]ŋ ta [o|u]ri m[o|u] kəʁakaj aŋ
S.FORM: makamong sira am, "ikongo ori o among ta ori, mo kehakay ang",
S.PHON: makam[o|u]ŋ ɕiɻa am ik[o|u]ŋ[o|u] [o|u]ɻi [o|u] am[o|u]ŋ ta [o|u]ɻi m[o|u] kəɰakaj aŋ
S.TRANSL: 每當他們撈到魚時，鬼就問＂朋友，我們撈到的是什麼魚？＂
When they caught some fish, the ghost asked, "What fish did we catch?"

S.FORM: "beken a arawa", "kong", "arawa", "ay, ra-rawa pa ya",
S.PHON: bəkən a arawa k[o|u]ŋ arawa aj rarawa pa ja
S.FORM: "beken a arawa", "kong", "arawa", "ay, rarawa pa ya",
S.PHON: bəkən a aɻawa k[o|u]ŋ aɻawa aj ɻaɻawa pa ja
S.TRANSL: ＂ ＂是arawa魚＂ ，＂什麼？＂ ＂arawa魚＂ ，＂哎，rarawa魚唷＂
"Arawa fish." "What?" "Arawa fish." "Oh, so we got rarawa fish."

S.FORM: "ji ka mi-zi-ziak am" koan na, ka-kozong da sia.
S.PHON: ʥi ka miʐiʐiak am k[o|u]an na kak[o|u]ʐ[o|u]ŋ ɖa ʂia
S.FORM: "ji ka miziziak am" koan na, kakozong da sia.
S.PHON: ʥi ka miririak am k[o|u]an na kak[o|u]r[o|u]ŋ ɖa ɕia
S.TRANSL: 人類說＂你不要說出來嘛＂ ，然後就把魚裝在網袋裡了
"You don't have to say it," the human said. The fisherman put the fish in a bag.

S.FORM: mi sia ma-naza do asa ka zawang am, akma sang,
S.PHON: mi ʂia manaʐa ɖ[o|u] aʂa ka ʐawaŋ am akma ʂaŋ
S.FORM: mi sia manaza do asa ka zawang am, akma sang,
S.PHON: mi ɕia manara ɖ[o|u] aʂa ka rawaŋ am akma ʂaŋ
S.TRANSL: 他們到下一個水溝去捕魚時，也跟前述的情形一樣
They went to the next channel to catch fish. What happened was the same.

S.FORM: ta "key! toyo rana" koan na, toyo-en na ori am, to na vowz-a no tao o vanaka am,
S.PHON: ta kəj t[o|u]j[o|u] rana k[o|u]an na t[o|u]j[o|u]ən na [o|u]ri am t[o|u] na v[o|u]wʐa n[o|u] ta[o|u] [o|u] vanaka am
S.FORM: ta "key! toyo rana" koan na, toyoen na ori am, to na vowza no tao o vanaka am,
S.PHON: ta kəj t[o|u]j[o|u] ɻana k[o|u]an na t[o|u]j[o|u]ən na [o|u]ɻi am t[o|u] na f[o|u]wra n[o|u] ta[o|u] [o|u] fanaka am
S.TRANSL: 人類說＂快，趕魚！＂ ，鬼就把棒子插入水溝裡並將魚趕到人類那裡去，人類則負責撈魚的工作
"Quick, startle the fish!" The ghost stuck the pole into the hole and herded the fish to the human, and the human did the catching.

S.FORM: "am-ian so among ta, mo ke-hakay?", "a o ya o among ta",
S.PHON: amian ʂ[o|u] am[o|u]ŋ ta m[o|u] kəʁakaj a [o|u] ja [o|u] am[o|u]ŋ ta
S.FORM: "amian so among ta, mo kehakay?", "a o ya o among ta",
S.PHON: amian ʂ[o|u] am[o|u]ŋ ta m[o|u] kəɰakaj a [o|u] ja [o|u] am[o|u]ŋ ta
S.TRANSL: ＂朋友，我們有沒有捕到魚？＂ ＂有啊＂
"Friend, did we catch any fish?" "Yes."

S.FORM: "ikongo o rararay, kakaray koan na am, ikongo o rararay" koan na no tao a.
S.PHON: ik[o|u]ŋ[o|u] [o|u] rararaj kakaraj k[o|u]an na am ik[o|u]ŋ[o|u] [o|u] rararaj k[o|u]an na n[o|u] ta[o|u] a
S.FORM: "ikongo o rararay, kakaray koan na am, ikongo o rararay" koan na no tao a.
S.PHON: ik[o|u]ŋ[o|u] [o|u] ɻaɻaɻaj kakaɻaj k[o|u]an na am ik[o|u]ŋ[o|u] [o|u] ɻaɻaɻaj k[o|u]an na n[o|u] ta[o|u] a
S.TRANSL: ＂什麼rararay？要說kakaray，怎麼說成rararay？＂
"What rararay? It's kakaray. How did it become rararay?" the human said.

S.FORM: "a ikongo" koan na no vangkas a, ori a ka-to da ma-naza-taza-n a,
S.PHON: a ik[o|u]ŋ[o|u] k[o|u]an na n[o|u] vaŋkaʂ a [o|u]ri a kat[o|u] ɖa manaʐataʐan a
S.FORM: "a ikongo" koan na no vangkas a, ori a kato da manazatazan a,
S.PHON: a ik[o|u]ŋ[o|u] k[o|u]an na n[o|u] faŋkaʂ a [o|u]ɻi a kat[o|u] ɖa manarataran a
S.TRANSL: ＂不然怎麼說嘛？＂ 鬼說，然後他們就繼續捕魚
"How do you say it then?" the ghost said, and they kept fishing.

S.FORM: ma-naza sira am, mak-among sira am, mahabteng,
S.PHON: manaʐa ʂira am makam[o|u]ŋ ʂira am maʁabtəŋ
S.FORM: manaza sira am, makamong sira am, mahabteng,
S.PHON: manara ɕiɻa am makam[o|u]ŋ ɕiɻa am maɰabtəŋ
S.TRANSL: 後來他們又捕到了mahabteng魚
They managed to catch mahabteng fish.

S.FORM: "ikongo o among ta, mo ke-hakay?", "mahabteng",
S.PHON: ik[o|u]ŋ[o|u] [o|u] am[o|u]ŋ ta m[o|u] kəʁakaj maʁabtəŋ
S.FORM: "ikongo o among ta, mo kehakay?", "mahabteng",
S.PHON: ik[o|u]ŋ[o|u] [o|u] am[o|u]ŋ ta m[o|u] kəɰakaj maɰabtəŋ
S.TRANSL: ＂我們捕到什麼魚？＂ ＂是mahabteng魚＂
"What did we get?" "mahabteng fish."

S.FORM: "ay, bebeteng pa ya", ji na pa-payok-a o ngaran no amo-among, inana pa-sala-en na,
S.PHON: aj bəbətəŋ pa ja ʥi na papaj[o|u]ka [o|u] ŋaran n[o|u] am[o|u]am[o|u]ŋ inana paʂalaən na
S.FORM: "ay, bebeteng pa ya", ji na papayoka o ngaran no amoamong, inana pasalaen na,
S.PHON: aj bəbətəŋ pa ja ʥi na papaj[o|u]ka [o|u] ŋaɻan n[o|u] am[o|u]am[o|u]ŋ inana paʂalaən na
S.TRANSL: ＂哎，我們捕到bebeteng魚唷＂ ，他都不說準確的魚名，而發奇怪的語音
"Oh, we caught bebeteng fish." Every time he said the name of a fish, he would pronounce it wrong, and it was always very strange.

S.FORM: ji na pa ni-moni do dang no tao, "asio ka ya, mo ke-hakay a, to mapa-sala so i-panci" koan na, "a ikongo"
S.PHON: ʥi na pa nim[o|u]ni ɖ[o|u] ɖaŋ n[o|u] ta[o|u] aʂi[o|u] ka ja m[o|u] kəʁakaj a t[o|u] mapaʂala ʂ[o|u] ipanci k[o|u]an na a ik[o|u]ŋ[o|u]
S.FORM: ji na pa nimoni do dang no tao, "asio ka ya, mo kehakay a, to mapasala so ipanci" koan na, "a ikongo"
S.PHON: ʥi na pa nim[o|u]ni ɖ[o|u] ɖaŋ n[o|u] ta[o|u] aɕi[o|u] ka ja m[o|u] kəɰakaj a t[o|u] mapaʂala ʂ[o|u] ipanʨi k[o|u]an na a ik[o|u]ŋ[o|u]
S.TRANSL: 但人類起先還沒有懷疑他，只是說＂朋友啊，你怎麼總是把每條魚的名字都唸得不正確？＂ ＂不然怎麼唸？＂
The human wasn't suspicious yet, only thinking that the other's pronunciation was strange, and said, "Friend, why do you keep on pronouncing the fish's names wrong?" "How are they pronounced, then?"

S.FORM: "ikong o among ta ori, mo ke-hakay ang?" "ilek",
S.PHON: ik[o|u]ŋ [o|u] am[o|u]ŋ ta [o|u]ri m[o|u] kəʁakaj aŋ ilək
S.FORM: "ikong o among ta ori, mo kehakay ang?" "ilek",
S.PHON: ik[o|u]ŋ [o|u] am[o|u]ŋ ta [o|u]ɻi m[o|u] kəɰakaj aŋ ilək
S.TRANSL: ＂朋友，我們捕到什麼魚？＂ ＂ilek魚＂
"Friend, what fish did we catch?" "Ilek fish."

S.FORM: "wo, ay, iilek pa ya", "a ya ka ma-kongo-kóngo, mo ke-hakay ya, so i-zi-ziak ya?"
S.PHON: w[o|u] aj iilək pa ja a ja ka mak[o|u]ŋ[o|u]k*ŋ[o|u] m[o|u] kəʁakaj ja ʂ[o|u] iʐiʐiak ja
S.FORM: "wo, ay, iilek pa ya", "a ya ka makongokongo, mo kehakay ya, so iziziak ya?"
S.PHON: w[o|u] aj iilək pa ja a ja ka mak[o|u]ŋ[o|u]k[o|u]ŋ[o|u] m[o|u] kəɰakaj ja ʂ[o|u] iririak ja
S.TRANSL: ＂喔唷，我們捕到iilek魚唷＂ ，＂朋友，你說什麼話，你是怎麼搞的？＂
"Oh, we got iilek fish." "Friend, what is wrong with you? What happened to your speech?"

S.FORM: to sira mak-among so angsa am, "ikongo ori?" "angsa",
S.PHON: t[o|u] ʂira makam[o|u]ŋ ʂ[o|u] aŋʂa am ik[o|u]ŋ[o|u] [o|u]ri aŋʂa
S.FORM: to sira makamong so angsa am, "ikongo ori?" "angsa",
S.PHON: t[o|u] ɕiɻa makam[o|u]ŋ ʂ[o|u] aŋʂa am ik[o|u]ŋ[o|u] [o|u]ɻi aŋʂa
S.TRANSL: 他們又捕到angsa魚，＂那是什麼魚？＂ ＂angsa魚＂
The next fish was angsa fish. "What fish is that?" "Angsa fish."

S.FORM: ilan-an na am, "maci-tpeh ya anito, a ikong na ji manci-an o ngara-ngaran no among a, ya ko i-panci a, na pa-sala-en,
S.PHON: ilanan na am macitpəʁ ja anit[o|u] a ik[o|u]ŋ na ʥi mancian [o|u] ŋaraŋaran n[o|u] am[o|u]ŋ a ja k[o|u] ipanci a na paʂalaən
S.FORM: ilanan na am, "macitpeh ya anito, a ikong na ji mancian o ngarangaran no among a, ya ko ipanci a, na pasalaen,
S.PHON: ilanan na am maʨitpəɰ ja anit[o|u] a ik[o|u]ŋ na ʥi manʨian [o|u] ŋaɻaŋaɻan n[o|u] am[o|u]ŋ a ja k[o|u] ipanʨi a na paʂalaən
S.TRANSL: 人類開始懷疑他，＂這個一定是鬼，我明明告訴他魚名，他卻用不同的說法講魚的名字？＂
The human started to become suspicious, and thought, "This has to be a ghost, or else why would he pronounce all the fish's names wrong? He always pronounces it strangely.

S.FORM: beken a oya rana am, anito ya, a ya todey maci-'eza jiaken a" koan na no tao am, to na na lita-i.
S.PHON: bəkən a [o|u]ja rana am anit[o|u] ja a ja t[o|u]ɖəj maciʔəʐa ʥiakən a k[o|u]an na n[o|u] ta[o|u] am t[o|u] na na litai
S.FORM: beken a oya rana am, anito ya, a ya todey maci'eza jiaken a" koan na no tao am, to na na litai.
S.PHON: bəkən a [o|u]ja ɻana am anit[o|u] ja a ja t[o|u]ɖəj maʨiʔəra ʥiakən a k[o|u]an na n[o|u] ta[o|u] am t[o|u] na na litai
S.TRANSL: 這個叫我一起捕魚的一定是個鬼＂ 人類這麼想，於是就想設計他
The guy who asked me to fish must be a ghost." Once the man thought of it this way, he started to scheme.

S.FORM: m-oli rana sira am, "hap-en ko o among ta" koan na no anito am,
S.PHON: m[o|u]li rana ʂira am ʁapən k[o|u] [o|u] am[o|u]ŋ ta k[o|u]an na n[o|u] anit[o|u] am
S.FORM: moli rana sira am, "hapen ko o among ta" koan na no anito am,
S.PHON: m[o|u]li ɻana ɕiɻa am ɰapən k[o|u] [o|u] am[o|u]ŋ ta k[o|u]an na n[o|u] anit[o|u] am
S.TRANSL: 他們要回家的時候，鬼說＂我提我們的魚哦＂
On their way back, the ghost said, "Let me carry the fish."

S.FORM: "ciaha, mo keypong, to ko na ngap-a, tarétarek a, ji rana a-nat ito a, ha-hap o totoyo ta", "nohon",
S.PHON: ciaʁa m[o|u] kəjp[o|u]ŋ t[o|u] k[o|u] na ŋapa tar*tarək a ʥi rana anat it[o|u] a ʁaʁap [o|u] t[o|u]t[o|u]j[o|u] ta n[o|u]ʁ[o|u]n
S.FORM: "ciaha, mo keypong, to ko na ngapa, taretarek a, ji rana anat ito a, hahap o totoyo ta", "nohon",
S.PHON: ʨiaɰa m[o|u] kəjp[o|u]ŋ t[o|u] k[o|u] na ŋapa taɻətaɻək a ʥi ɻana anat it[o|u] a ɰaɰap [o|u] t[o|u]t[o|u]j[o|u] ta n[o|u]ɰ[o|u]n
S.TRANSL: ＂沒關係啦，親愛的，還是我提好了，才這些魚，還不至於提不動，你拿趕魚棒吧＂ ，＂好啦＂
"It is okay. Let me carry it. There aren't that many, and it isn't that heavy. You can carry the fish poking rod." "Okay."

S.FORM: karaan am, "yaken rana, mo ke-hakay am, to mo pa-nanal-a yaken do jia, ya ko k-adas-an a, mi ko pa m-obot an" koan na,
S.PHON: karaan am jakən rana m[o|u] kəʁakaj am t[o|u] m[o|u] pananala jakən ɖ[o|u] ʥia ja k[o|u] kaɖaʂan a mi k[o|u] pa m[o|u]b[o|u]t an k[o|u]an na
S.FORM: karaan am, "yaken rana, mo kehakay am, to mo pananala yaken do jia, ya ko kadasan a, mi ko pa mobot an" koan na,
S.PHON: kaɻaan am jakən ɻana m[o|u] kəɰakaj am t[o|u] m[o|u] pananala jakən ɖ[o|u] ʥia ja k[o|u] kaɖaʂan a mi k[o|u] pa m[o|u]b[o|u]t an k[o|u]an na
S.TRANSL: ＂朋友，你在這裡等我一下，我大便很急，先去大便一下＂ 人類說
"Friend, please wait here for me. I need to have a bowel movement badly," the human said.

S.FORM: ma-níring o tao am, "ciaha, to ko pa-lolo-a, ta ciaha, ta ya m-ian jimo o kawalan",
S.PHON: man*riŋ [o|u] ta[o|u] am ciaʁa t[o|u] k[o|u] pal[o|u]l[o|u]a ta ciaʁa ta ja mian ʥim[o|u] [o|u] kawalan
S.FORM: maniring o tao am, "ciaha, to ko paloloa, ta ciaha, ta ya mian jimo o kawalan",
S.PHON: maniɻiŋ [o|u] ta[o|u] am ʨiaɰa t[o|u] k[o|u] pal[o|u]l[o|u]a ta ʨiaɰa ta ja mian ʥim[o|u] [o|u] kawalan
S.TRANSL: 人類說＂沒關係，我就帶著，因為你那裡有趕魚棒＂
"It is okay, I will take it. You still have the bamboo fish poking rod in your hand," the man said.

S.FORM: mi mozi-mozib am, mi t-om-ayo, ka-ozib na rana am, ma-la-láyo rana o tao a, to ma-la-layo a to ma-la-láyo o tao.
S.PHON: mi m[o|u]ʐim[o|u]ʐib am mi t[o|u]maj[o|u] ka[o|u]ʐib na rana am malal*j[o|u] rana [o|u] ta[o|u] a t[o|u] malalaj[o|u] a t[o|u] malal*j[o|u] [o|u] ta[o|u]
S.FORM: mi mozimozib am, mi tomayo, kaozib na rana am, malalayo rana o tao a, to malalayo a to malalayo o tao.
S.PHON: mi m[o|u]rim[o|u]rib am mi t[o|u]maj[o|u] ka[o|u]rib na ɻana am malalaj[o|u] ɻana [o|u] ta[o|u] a t[o|u] malalaj[o|u] a t[o|u] malalaj[o|u] [o|u] ta[o|u]
